scenes.picture: Chidi proudly holding up a white senator suit in his small campus hostel room, smiling widely.
scenes.dialogue: Omo, tomorrow na my final year presentation. This white outfit go scatter eyes!
scenes.caption: Chidi ready to pepper them with ginger.

scenes.picture: Chidi eating a heavy plate of palm oil-soaked local rice and stew while sitting on his hostel bed in his underwear.
scenes.dialogue: Make I chop small before I iron this cloth. Wet fit happen sef?
scenes.caption: Famous last words before village people start work.

scenes.picture: A massive red palm oil stain right in the middle of the white senator top, with Chidi staring at it in total shock, mouth wide open.
scenes.dialogue: Jesus! Egbami o! Stew don colonize my future!
scenes.caption: Ankara would never experience this type of heartbreak.

scenes.picture: Chidi frantically scrubbing the white top inside a small plastic bucket with blue detergent, foaming everywhere, looking sweaty.
scenes.dialogue: Wetin be dis? Why the red stain dey turn pinkish-blue like bruise?
scenes.caption: Local chemist chemistry gone wrong.

scenes.picture: Chidi crying on the floor holding the ruined, multicolored tie-dye mess of a shirt, while his roommate laughs hysterically.
scenes.dialogue: My presentation dey by 9 AM. Na to go wear my NYSC camo remain!
scenes.caption: From Senator to camouflage guerrilla fighter.

scenes.picture: A Neat Naija attendant in a clean green uniform smiling and handing the spotless, perfectly ironed white senator suit back to a relieved Chidi.
scenes.dialogue: No worry Chidi, Neat Naija don rescue your GPA!
scenes.caption: Laundry, house, office, sofa and carpet cleaning. DM to book.
